versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "周末遛弯路线 Walk Route" (v1.0.0) skill
- Generates custom walking routes based on user location and desired distance, automatically connecting parks, lakesides, coffee shops, etc.
- Prioritizes looped routes returning to the starting point, with options for various themes (coffee tour, park loop, riverside walk)
- Provides a Gaode Map QR code for instant route navigation in the app
- Supports scenarios including walking, jogging, dog-walking, and family strolls
- Requires setup of the AMAP_API_KEY environment variable for access to Gaode Map Web Service APIs
